summary.en: The film's one whiteout on the drop: two white frames, the answer slams in amber while the ground falls back from white, its line read as a claim in a pause.
summary.zh: 全片唯一一次白闪落在音乐的 drop 上：两帧白，答案以琥珀色砸进来，底色从白落回深色，下面一句作为主张在停顿里读完。

fits: The climax of a question film: the measured answer, once.
notFor: A second peak in the same film; an answer that is not a measured value; the opening.

intent.en: The peak is marked by being the only flash: the answer arrives on the hit, in the one colour that means "answer", and is given time to sink in.
intent.zh: 高潮靠“唯一一次闪白”来标记：答案踩着重拍到来，用唯一代表“答案”的颜色，并留出时间让人消化。

content.en: The answer value (≤ 7 chars, usually computed), one line read as a claim (≤ 30 chars), an optional query (≤ 48 chars).
content.zh: 答案值（≤ 5 字，通常是算出来的）、一句作为主张来读的话（≤ 12 字）、可选查询行。

fits.zh: 提问式片子的高潮：测得的答案，只用一次。

notFor.zh: 同一支片里的第二个高潮；不是测量值的答案；开场。

en: One per film: a second flash makes the first ordinary.
Keep the answer in the normal-width Bold: the portal needs its counter.
zh: 一支片只用一次：第二次闪白会让第一次变平常。
答案保持常规宽度的粗体：穿越转场要用它的字腔。

overlaps.note: runtime frame-level transition: the exposure build into the hit; this scene paints the frames after the hit, the ground falling from white so the answer keeps a clean edge

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
